headline_marked: US Space Force tests [[private space rendezvous]] with True Anomaly, Rocket Lab
headline: US Space Force tests private space rendezvous with True Anomaly, Rocket Lab
summary: The US Space Force conducted a complex orbital mission with startups True Anomaly and Rocket Lab.
details: The US Space Force recently conducted a complex orbital mission, dubbed Victus Haze, with the help of two space startups, True Anomaly and Rocket Lab. The mission involved two rival satellites meeting up in orbit, with one capturing imagery of the other.

The exercise demonstrated the close inspection of a space vehicle soon after it arrived in orbit, a necessity in a world where the US, Russia and China are deploying novel space weapons. True Anomaly's Jackal spacecraft intercepted Rocket Lab's Puma spacecraft, capturing imagery of different parts of the vehicle.

The mission was notable for its complexity, with Rocket Lab launching Puma just 16 hours and 42 minutes after receiving notice. True Anomaly's CEO said that, outside of NASA and Space Force space flight missions with humans, 'this is probably the most complex rendezvous and proximity operation between two spacecraft in modern history.'

The two companies are prepared to perform new exercises in the weeks ahead with increasing difficulty, which could include Rocket Lab's Puma trying to evade True Anomaly’s Jackal and performing its own inspection maneuvers. True Anomaly has raised just over $1 billion, including a $650 million round in March.

headline_marked: iOS 27 [[detects scams in real-time]] for apps
headline: iOS 27 detects scams in real-time for apps
summary: New iOS 27 framework helps apps detect scams via voice calls, texts, emails
details: A new iOS 27 framework will help apps fight back against social engineering scams as they unfold via voice calls, text messages, emails, and more.
This framework aims to detect scams in real-time, providing users with alerts and options to proceed with caution.
The update is part of Apple's ongoing efforts to enhance user security and privacy features.
caption:

A new iOS 27 framework will help apps fight back against social engineering scams as they unfold via voice calls, text messages, emails, and more.
